name: Service Install and Changes
description: Service installation (7045, 4697), start-type changes, start failures, crashes and state changes (Service Control Manager in the System log). Service installs are a common persistence and remote-execution (PsExec-style) step.
author: EventHawk (Microsoft documentation, SANS, Sigma)

event_descriptions.7032: Service Control Manager failed to take a recovery action
